app: FlatDesk: Zendesk alternative with AI included at a flat price (built on Chatwoot)

personas.role: Tier-1 support agent at a 7-agent Shopify brand
personas.cares_about: Closing tickets fast with good CSAT so the queue never runs away; hitting first-response SLA.
personas.time_spent: Most of the day in the inbox: reading tickets, looking up orders in Shopify, typing the same 'where is my order' answers.
personas.struggles: Switching between the helpdesk and Shopify admin for every order question; repetitive answers; AI drafts that don't know the order or promise things nobody did.
personas.how_helps: AI-drafted reply filled with the live order and tracking, customer context in the right bar, and one button that does the action (replacement, claim, refund) and sends.

tasks.name: Open a ticket that needs a human and see THAT customer's context
expect: [data-testid='handoff']:has-text('Refunds or replacements over $100 go to a human')

tasks.name: Create the replacement and send in one step; the thread and order card update
A prospect shows no orders and no refund buttons
Macros are ranked for this ticket's intent and insert into the reply
expect: #reply-box:has-text('Want me to pause it for you?')

tasks.name: Search finds a conversation and opens it with its customer
As an agent, Billing and Admin are hidden and 'Mine' shows my queue

personas.cares_about: SLA compliance, balanced workload, coaching agents.
personas.time_spent: Watching the queue, reassigning tickets, chasing breaches, weekly 1:1s.
personas.struggles: No single view of tickets about to breach; finds out after the fact; reassigning blind.
personas.how_helps: An 'SLA at risk' view with live timers, a defined threshold and today's breach count; a picker that preselects the lowest-load agent; workload by agent that matches the inbox.

tasks.name: As a lead, start in the SLA view with a definition and today's numbers
Reassign a ticket; the lowest-load online agent is preselected and the header and list update
Confirm the reassignment
expect: .thread .msg.event:has-text('Reassigned from Leo S. to Priya K.')

tasks.name: Workload in Reports reflects the reassignment and the right bar lists at-risk tickets
Open an agent's queue from Reports to bulk-reassign
Notifications list breached tickets and open the right one

personas.cares_about: CSAT, cost per conversation, headcount plan, what share the AI resolves, and a story for the board.
personas.time_spent: Reports, vendor reviews, planning peak-season staffing.
personas.struggles: Zendesk AI billed per resolution makes cost unpredictable; can't prove AI quality isn't hurting CSAT; can't show the board savings.
personas.how_helps: Reports with one shared period, AI vs human CSAT with sample sizes, reopen rate, software cost per conversation, savings vs a hedged Zendesk estimate, a 12-week trend and an 8-week peak forecast.

tasks.name: Read AI rate, split CSAT, cost and savings for one stated period
Change the period once; Reports and AI agent both follow
Definitions and a board export sit in the Reports right bar

personas.cares_about: Predictable software spend; no surprise invoices; renewal terms; budget vs actual.
personas.time_spent: Month-end close, approving vendor bills, budget vs actual.
personas.struggles: Per-resolution AI fees and seat hikes make the helpdesk bill swing month to month; paying two vendors during a switch.
personas.how_helps: Flat bill with a clear rule above fair use, a hedged Zendesk comparison, the transition-month overlap, invoices, terms, plan ladder and a 12-month projection.

tasks.name: As finance, see the bill, the fair-use rule and the transition month
Invoices, payment method and notice terms
Plan ladder and 12-month projection for budgeting growth
The comparison is hedged and can be replaced with a real invoice
expect: #panel-billing:has-text("Zendesk doesn't publish a single per-resolution rate")

personas.cares_about: Revenue, repeat purchases, not losing sales to slow replies, and not wasting a week on a migration before peak season.
personas.time_spent: Everywhere; checks support when something breaks.
personas.struggles: Fear that switching helpdesks loses ticket history and breaks things right before Black Friday.
personas.how_helps: Migration tab shows a dated, completed summary with proof (spot-check), a named contact, rollback plan, next actions with owners and a peak-readiness checklist; Reports show revenue in open tickets.

tasks.name: Migration status with dates, guarantee, peak readiness and a named contact
Spot-check that history arrived intact
See exactly who got the DNS instructions and when
The open peak item links to where it gets done
Revenue at stake in open tickets

personas.cares_about: SSO, access control, data ownership, compliance evidence, being able to leave.
personas.time_spent: User provisioning, security reviews, vendor questionnaires.
personas.struggles: Lock-in, unclear data location and AI processing; exporting from Zendesk was painful.
personas.how_helps: Admin shows enforced SSO, SCIM, roles, regions, backups, scoped scheduled exports, compliance documents, AI processing and an audit log.

tasks.name: As IT, see SSO enforcement and the audit log
Regions, backups and a scoped, scheduled export
Users, roles and SCIM provisioning
The rail's gear is labelled Admin and opens Admin
Switch to the agent role: Admin is hidden

personas.role: Ops manager serving Spanish-speaking customers on WhatsApp
personas.cares_about: Answering customers in their channel and language; fewer missed messages.
personas.time_spent: Juggling a separate WhatsApp phone and the helpdesk.
personas.struggles: WhatsApp lives outside the helpdesk; translations are manual; the 24h window rule causes failed sends.
personas.how_helps: WhatsApp is a channel with unread and waiting counts, a 24h-window timer, templates when it closes, translations under every message and draft, and drafts that only claim actions that were done.

tasks.name: WhatsApp view with unread/waiting counts; open a Spanish conversation and see that customer
Show translations of the message and the draft
Open the claim and send; the claim ID appears on the order card
A closed 24h window switches the composer to templates

personas.cares_about: Deflection: more questions answered by the AI and articles.
personas.time_spent: Writing and updating articles; reviewing what customers ask.
personas.struggles: Doesn't know which questions the AI fails on or what it said.
personas.how_helps: AI agent tab lists gaps for the shared period with sample conversations and handoff reasons in the right bar, an in-place editor that publishes to help centre and AI, and deflection metrics.

tasks.name: See gaps and the selected gap's details
Pick a gap: the right bar shows its sample conversations
Draft and publish an article in place
Deflection metrics and stale or untranslated articles
Switch to the last 7 days: the gap list follows

personas.cares_about: Routing, automations and macros that keep handle time down and the AI behaving safely; a clean cutover with no lost triggers.
personas.time_spent: Building triggers, views, SLAs, macros and integrations; fixing broken automations after changes.
personas.struggles: Zendesk triggers/automations and app integrations don't map 1:1 on migration; AI rules are a black box.
personas.how_helps: A Rules page that shows each migrated Zendesk trigger/SLA policy next to its FlatDesk equivalent, plus AI guardrails and handoff rules they can edit and test.

tasks.name: As support ops admin, open Admin › Rules and see trigger mapping status
Change the $100 handoff guardrail and test it on a sample ticket
Save it: the audit log and the AI tab show the new rule
The AI agent tab uses the same rule wording
expect: [data-testid='guardrails']:has-text('Refunds or replacements over $150 go to a human')

personas.cares_about: Reply quality and brand voice from both humans and the AI; fewer wrong promises and refunds.
personas.time_spent: Sampling and scoring conversations, writing feedback, running onboarding for new agents.
personas.struggles: No easy way to sample AI replies and see where it promised something wrong.
personas.how_helps: An AI review queue with random samples, a scorecard and 'fix the answer' that feeds the AI's knowledge.

tasks.name: Open the AI review queue with its scorecard
Score five AI replies, flagging the wrong promise
Save the correction; it feeds the AI's knowledge

personas.cares_about: GDPR/CCPA compliance, DPAs, data deletion requests, AI processing disclosures.
personas.time_spent: Reviewing vendor contracts, handling access and deletion requests, maintaining records of processing.
personas.struggles: Can't confirm where helpdesk and AI data is processed or delete a customer everywhere.
personas.how_helps: Admin shows DPA, subprocessors, AI provider and training policy; the customer card has a confirm step to delete or export that customer, covering conversations and AI logs, recorded in the audit log.

tasks.name: Find the DPA, subprocessors and AI processing terms
Downloading the DPA is recorded in the audit log
Process a deletion request from THAT customer's card
The request shows in the Admin audit log

personas.cares_about: Converting café and office inquiries into accounts quickly.
personas.struggles: Wholesale leads arrive in the support inbox and get answered late or by the AI with the wrong info.
personas.how_helps: 'Route to sales' sends the lead to a Sales inbox with SLA and CRM sync; the AI tags B2B intent and never quotes wholesale prices.

tasks.name: As sales, only the Sales inbox is visible with Ben's routed inquiry
See why it was routed and the prepared price list
Reply with the price list; the lead syncs to the CRM

personas.cares_about: Subscription churn, repeat purchase, reviews and Instagram DM sentiment.
personas.time_spent: Analyzing churn reasons, running win-back flows, managing social inboxes.
personas.struggles: Cancel reasons and product complaints are buried in tickets.
personas.how_helps: Reports tag contact reasons with trends and track how many cancel requests a pause offer saved, with revenue kept.

tasks.name: Contact reasons and cancel saves for the period
Switch to the last 7 days; both cards follow

personas.cares_about: Fewer mis-picks and damaged shipments; fast replacements.
personas.time_spent: Managing pick/pack, carrier claims and replacement orders.
personas.struggles: Hears about wrong grind or ripped bags only when finance sees refunds.
personas.how_helps: Auto-tagged fulfilment issues with order/SKU/carrier counts for the period, a weekly digest, and links into the conversation.

tasks.name: Fulfilment issues for the last 7 days by SKU and carrier
Open one issue's conversation and see its order

personas.cares_about: Meeting contracted SLAs with a shared seat pool and clear billing.
personas.time_spent: Scheduling shifts across clients, monitoring queues.
personas.struggles: Seat-based pricing and per-client access separation.
personas.how_helps: Flat plan with agent groups and restricted access per inbox and hours; seat use is visible before inviting.

tasks.name: See current seat use and groups
Prepare an Overflow group: email only, evenings, seat impact shown
Create it: groups, seats and audit log update
The peak checklist item is now done
